_comment: Hand-written raw-spec.json, used by checks.resolve-sources. One plugin per reject symbol in
docs/plans/28-validate-plugin-sources.md §3.3 (A-M, plus J's sub-case J'), 19 total -- D, E, I
and K each have a second plugin covering a second way to hit the same symbol.
The exact wording of each rejection is pinned in tests/source-parse-test.lua, not here --
this fixture and its check only assert the *shape* of the failure output (one line per
plugin, sorted by name, plugin name and URL both present) so a reworded message stays a
one-file change. See that file's header and checks.resolve-sources' comment in flake.nix.
nourl.nvim and emptyurl.nvim (A/B) are the two deliberate exceptions with no URL to quote.
ftp.nvim also carries a version constraint: its URL is rejected by parse_source, so it must
not be enqueued for git ls-remote (no --lazy-provided host here can reach the network at all,
so a regression would surface as a second, contradictory error line for ftp.nvim instead of
the one this fixture's line-count assertion expects).
